name: Březina (Brno-Country District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part bearing a green birch leaf and a green lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 19 January 2007 (decision No. 15) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
